name: lz4
description: Lz4 is a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed greater than 500 MB/s per core. It features an extremely fast decoder, with speed in multiple GB/s per core. Lz4 can work with Zstandard to allow both algorithms to compress data faster.

installed_descriptions.name: lz4
installed_descriptions.description: Compresses or decompresses files using the LZ4 format

installed_descriptions.name: lz4c
installed_descriptions.description: Compresses files using the LZ4 format

installed_descriptions.name: lz4cat
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the contents of a file compressed using the LZ4 format

installed_descriptions.name: unlz4
installed_descriptions.description: Decompresses files using the LZ4 format

installed_descriptions.name: liblz4
installed_descriptions.description: The library implementing lossless data compression, using the LZ4 algorithm
